mapper.select: SELECT id,filename,status,chunk_count,error,created_at,storage_scope FROM documents WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND storage_scope='LIBRARY' ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT * FROM documents WHERE id=#{id} AND owner_id=#{owner}
mapper.update: UPDATE documents SET status=#{status},chunk_count=#{count},error=#{error} WHERE id=#{id} AND status != 'DISCARDED'
UPDATE documents SET task_id=#{task} WHERE id=#{id} AND owner_id=#{owner} AND storage_scope='TASK' AND task_id IS NULL AND status='READY'
UPDATE documents SET status='DISCARDED' WHERE id=#{id} AND owner_id=#{owner} AND storage_scope='TASK' AND task_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sessions WHERE owner_id=#{owner} ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT * FROM sessions WHERE id=#{id} AND owner_id=#{owner}
SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE id=#{id} AND owner_id=#{owner}
SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND idempotency_key=#{key}
SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE owner_id=#{owner} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 30 OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE tasks SET status=#{status},result=#{result},error=#{error} WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING')
UPDATE tasks SET status='RUNNING' WHERE id=#{id} AND status='QUEUED'
UPDATE tasks SET status='FAILED',error='服务重启，执行已中断；未自动重新调用模型' WHERE status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING')
UPDATE agent_runs SET status='FAILED',result='服务重启，执行中断' WHERE status='RUNNING'
UPDATE tool_calls SET status='FAILED',result='服务重启，执行中断' WHERE status='RUNNING'
UPDATE documents SET status='FAILED',error='索引因服务重启中断，请重新上传' WHERE status='INDEXING'
UPDATE agent_runs SET status=#{status},result=#{result},steps=#{steps} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM agent_runs WHERE task_id=#{task} ORDER BY created_at,id
mapper.update: UPDATE tool_calls SET status=#{status},result=#{result},duration_ms=#{duration} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tool_calls WHERE task_id=#{task} ORDER BY created_at,id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO evidence(task_id,chunk_id,document_id,payload) VALUES(#{task},#{chunk},#{document},#{payload}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE payload=VALUES(payload)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM task_events WHERE task_id=#{task} AND id > #{after} ORDER BY id LIMIT 200
mapper.update: UPDATE tasks SET review_status=#{decision},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{task} AND owner_id=#{owner} AND status='SUCCEEDED' AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM reviews WHERE task_id=#{task} ORDER BY id DESC
